title.narrative: CEOSS/Resilience Based Equitable Sustainable Growth for Rural Women
CEOSS/Resilience Based Equitable Sustainable Growth for Rural Women

description.narrative: The project will be implemented through 2 axes. The first axis relates to the capacity building of the partner CBOs, elected committees, and farmers cooperatives regarding climate change issues and impacts. Those entities will help their communities achieve resilience regarding climate changes and food security, while ensuring women’s participation and representation in all stages. The second axis is concerned with the implementation of local initiatives by target rural women and youth that apply climate-smart agriculture initiatives that enhance their skills and generate income, after the provision of related trainings. The project will be implemented through a set of objectives, results, and activities, together with measurable indicators. The project will apply a set of developmental approaches: rights-based, resilience, capacity building, and participatory approaches. It will undergo regular monitoring and evaluation to ensure optimum implementation. A final internal evaluation will be implemented to document the project’s success stories, lessons learnt, gaps, and future plans. The project will be implemented in 4 governorates (Minia, Beni Sueif, 4Qalyoubia, and Fayoum) in 8 rural communities. The project targets 800 citizens (climate awareness) and 400 women and youth (improved livelihoods and socioeconomic conditions). The project targets 8 CBOs, 4 farmers cooperatives, and 8 elected committees.
